answer: The Weekly community check-in streak over one year verified by witness countersignatures turns patience into the price of identity: every week the applicant signs in, the witness countersignatures go on the public record, and one missed week resets the streak to zero, so one real person can keep a single identity alive while a farm cannot keep hundreds. Even a quiet terrace gets heard, because attendance weighs persistence, not volume. From the ivory to the basalt, the same rule holds: no presence, no trust, no exception.
